newsitem.title: USA: Ex-N.J. Gov Florio urges property tax vote - paper.
newsitem.headline: Ex-N.J. Gov Florio urges property tax vote - paper.

text.p: Former New Jersey Gov Jim Florio called for a public referendum on ending the property tax system to pay for public schools, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Wednesday.

Florio, who is exploring a possible rematch against Gov Christine Whitman to retake his old job, said property taxes are regressive and force local officials to compete against each other for new development.
The referendum proposed by Florio would not be binding on the state Legislature, but Florio said voter approval of the idea would put pressure on lawmakers to act.
The former governor, who lost in a tight race against Whitman in 1993, did not offer alternative funding mechanisms, saying his proposal was only intended to spark debate.
